declarations.type:
∀ (reportCount faultBudget rank : Nat)
  (actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound selected :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.VotingWeight)
  (belowActualCount aboveLiveCount : Nat),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinGeneralAuthorityOrderStatistic.ZeroIndexedRankWindow reportCount
      faultBudget rank →
    belowActualCount ≤ faultBudget →
      aboveLiveCount ≤ faultBudget →
        (selected < actualFaultWeight → rank + 1 ≤ belowActualCount) →
          (liveUpperBound < selected → reportCount ≤ rank + aboveLiveCount) →
            actualFaultWeight ≤ selected ∧ selected ≤ liveUpperBound
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinGeneralAuthorityOrderStatistic.rank_certified_order_statistic_is_safe_and_live
